quantumEscape.name: Quantum Escape
quantumEscape.summary: Phase out of normal space: immune to damage and faster, but unable to attack.
quantumEscape.limits: You cannot fire, launch rockets or drop mines while phased. Slows still apply. Ends if you jump through a gate.
quantumEscape.details.0: Immune to all damage for 3 s
empShockwave.name: EMP Shockwave
empShockwave.summary: A 900-unit pulse that wipes enemy targeting. No damage, allies unaffected.
empShockwave.limits: Does not stop shots already in flight and does not immobilise.
empShockwave.details.0: Aliens lose their target for 6 s
empShockwave.details.1: Enemy pilots cannot lock on for 3 s
empShockwave.details.3: Affected targets are immune for 15 s
guardianLink.name: Guardian Link
guardianLink.summary: Links up to 3 squad mates and takes part of the damage they receive.
guardianLink.limits: A mate further than 900 is not covered. Redirected damage is never passed on again.
guardianLink.details.0: 35% of their damage is redirected to you
guardianLink.details.2: Links squad mates within 700 for 8 s
nanoRestoration.name: Nano Restoration
nanoRestoration.summary: Nanite field that repairs up to 3 ships, the most damaged first.
nanoRestoration.limits: Never repairs beyond maximum. Does not stack with another Warden on the same ship.
nanoRestoration.details.0: Restores 25% hull and 15% shield over 6 s
nanoRestoration.details.1: Half strength on your own ship
shieldBreaker.name: Shield Breaker
shieldBreaker.summary: Piercing volleys: a larger share of your laser damage reaches the hull.
shieldBreaker.limits: Total damage is unchanged. When the shield runs out the rest still hits the hull.
gravitationalHook.name: Gravitational Hook
gravitationalHook.summary: Hooks your target within 650: it slows down while you speed up.
gravitationalHook.limits: Breaks beyond 975. The target cannot be hooked again for 10 s.
industrialOverdrive.name: Industrial Overdrive
industrialOverdrive.summary: Extraction and loot systems at full power.
industrialOverdrive.limits: Respects loot ownership and the space left in your hold.
industrialOverdrive.details.1: Collects loot and wrecks within 450 automatically
bastionMode.name: Bastion Mode
bastionMode.summary: Hexagonal armour: shrug off damage and draw aliens away from your squad.
bastionMode.limits: Never forces enemy pilots to target you.
bastionMode.details.1: Ordinary aliens within 900 attack you; bosses switch to you
deathMark.name: Death Mark
deathMark.summary: Marks your target: your lasers hit it harder, but you are exposed.
deathMark.limits: The bonus is yours alone; allies do not share it.
deathMark.details.0: Your laser damage to the marked target +20%
imperialSupremacy.name: Imperial Supremacy
imperialSupremacy.summary: Overcharged batteries: more damage and reach at the cost of mobility.
imperialSupremacy.limits: No crowd control and no protection for the group.
